descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S24 「打字的床旁文字不点保存也会存：换标签页和刷新后还在，两种模式，不串」 Typed encounter text saves with no save tap: survives a tab switch and a reload, both modes, no bleed

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Each encounter's transcript is saved automatically, with no manual step. After 2+ visits, the earlier visit's transcript is there for reference without re-dictating.（UAT TC-16；TFA-92594 How it works 1；TFA-92594 AC 2）
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, and passes in both.（UAT 3.3；TFA-92594 AC 2）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Standard fixture ({hospitalPatient}, {snfResident})

When Type into each chart's encounter box without pressing Save & Extract or Generate; go to Pre-Round and back; reload; then check the other chart

Then Each typed text is still in its own chart's box after the reload and never appears in the other chart

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs. cp1 mustContain QA16-TYPED-H and mustNotContain QA16-TYPED-N. cp2 mustContain QA16-TYPED-N and mustNotContain QA16-TYPED-H. cp3 mustContain QA16-TYPED-H and mustNotContain QA16-TYPED-N (U1 same-day save, U8). Whether and when this text then appears as a prior entry is Q8 / S10 / S11

在哪跑：dev 单元 U07；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S24 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-16.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。

UAT item: TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-16/S24

Tickets: TFA-92594 Prior Encounter Transcripts (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (generated/tc16s24/verdict.json). Agent: 46 turns, 174 s, $0.32.

Plan: unit U07 (#7, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Typed encounter text autosaves. Legacy seed; it types into both Encounter boxes (autosaved), which every later part on these charts would see.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #7, U07; checked: yes): Pass — typed encounter text survives reload in both modes and after switching back; no transcript row invented
